title_sq: Apartament 3+1+2 ne shitje ne Bllok prapa Kinema Agimit ne Tirane (ID 4131393)
description_sq:
Ne Bllok prapa Kinema Agimit shitet apartament me tipologji 3+1+2 i sapo restauruar ,siperfaqe 96 m² neto me Hipoteke, kati 2 , organizohet ne 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, 1 ballkon, orientimi me diell. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i investuar dhe i mobiluar. Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me prestigjoze ne Tirane, mjaft te qete e cila ofron te gjitha facilitetet.
Apartamenti shitet me cmimin 320,000€
title_en: Apartment 3+1+2 for sale in the block behind Agimit Cinema in Tirana (ID 4131393)
description_en: In the block behind Kinema Agimit, a newly restored 3+1+2 apartment is for sale, surface area 96 m² net with mortgage, 2nd floor, organized in 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 1 balcony, sunny orientation. The apartment is fully invested and furnished. The apartment is located in one of the most prestigious areas in Tirana, quite quiet, which offers all facilities.
